s: Din heqqep mechitztzot leshabbat ubo ch' seipim: yachid sheshshabat bebiqa, vehiqqip mechitztzot geruot kegon sheti belo ereb o ereb belo sheti, al derek sheyyitbaer besimman shs"b shehen moilot laasotah reshut hayyachid gemura min hattora, apillu yesh bo kamma milin, vehazzoreq letoko mereshut harabbim chayyab — ap al pi ken middibre soperim en moilot lehattir hattiltul betokan umittokan lirshut hayyachid gemura ella kesheen betokan raq bet satayim, veaz muttar apillu asa ken beyishshub, ap al pi sheepshar lo laasot mechitztzot gemurot. Abal im yesh betokan yoter mibbet satayim, en metaltelin betokan ella bed' ammot kemo bekarmelit. Abal hammaqqip bimchitztzot gemurot, muttar letaltel betokan apillu yesh betokan yoter mibbet satayim, veenan keqarpep shello huqqap ledira, shehare hiqqipan ladur bahen beshabbat:

Abal shayyara shechonta bebiqa vehiqqipuha mechitztzot geruot, apillu hu heqqep gadol meod — metaltelim bekullo, shemmittok shehem rabbim hittiru lahem letaltel kol tzorkam. Veen rabbim pechutim mishshalosh. Ubilbad shello yaqqipu yoter midday mikkede tzorkam, shello yishshaer bet satayim panuy sheen tzarik lahem letashmish kelehem ubehemtam. Abal im nishar bet satayim panuy — en metaltelin bekol hammuqqap ella bd' ammot, shehare hu parutz bemilluo lemaqom haasur, dehaynu lebet satayim happanuy. Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshehiqqipu yoter al shesh sein. Abal im lo hiqqipu yater al shesh, ap al pi shennishar bet satayim lahem panuy, sheen tzarik lahem ella d' sein — muttar, kevan shehem shelosha ulekol echad yesh lo satayim. Veyesh choleqin. Uleinyan halaka, bedibre soperim hallek achar hammeqel:

Abal shenayim shechanu bebiqa — dinam keyachid, veen lishnehem yachad ella bet satayim bilbad, ap al pi shehen tzerikim leyoter. Veim yesh immahem nokri, eno mitztarep immahem lihyot shayyara. Veyesh omerim shehu haddin leqatan:

Hayu shelosha, vehiqqipu kol tzorkam yoter mibbet satayim, umet echad mehen beshabbat — muttarim kol hashshabbat kullah, kevan shenniknesa shabbat behetter, vehoil vehuttera — huttera. Hayu shenayim, vehiqqipuha yoter mibbet satayim, venittosepu alehem beshabbat — asurim, kevan shenniknesa shabbat beissur, shehashshabbat goremet:

Hayu shelosha, vehiqqipu kol echad leatzmo zeh betzad zeh ladur bahem beshabbat, veerebu yachad, im hachitzonim rechabim vehaemtzai qatzar, shennimtza haemtzai parutz bemilluo lehachitzonim, vehachitzonim enam perutzim bemilluam laemtzai ella yesh lahem gippupim odepim alayv mikkan umikkan — hare diyyure hachitzonim moshelim baemtzai, dehaynu sheanu roim keillu hem gam ken darim betoko, vahare yesh shelosha beyachad, shehare en mechitztza lachatzotz beno lebenam, kevan shennipratz lahem bemilluo, vahare hu keqeren zaviyyot lahem, sheeno choleq reshut leatzmo. Ulepikak muttarim letaltel baemtzai apillu hu gadol harbeh, kevan shennaasu bo shayyara. Veap bachitzonim muttarim letaltel, lepi shehem nechshabim kechatzer lehaemtzai, shehu bet dira lahem, shennaasu bo shayyara. Veyesh omerim shehachitzonim enam muttarim ella ad satayim, shehare hem enam reshut achat zeh im zeh, mippene gippupehem hammapsiqin benehem. Veim heqqep echad mehem yoter missatayim, gam haemtzai asur, shehare hu parutz bemilluo lemaqom haasur. Abal hachitzon hashsheni, sheen bo ella satayim, muttar. Uleinyan halaka, bedibre soperim hallek achar hammeqel:

Veim haemtzai rachab mehachitzonim, shennimtzeu hachitzonim perutzim bemilluam laemtzai, vehaemtzai yesh lo gippupim odepim alehem mikkan umikkan — im yachid bezeh veyachid bezeh veyachid bezeh, en notenin lekol echad ella bet satayim, shehare diyyure hachitzonim enam baemtzai, kevan shehu eno parutz bemilluo, ella haemtzai hu bekol echad mehem, shehem perutzim lo bemilluam, venimtza sheen bekol echad mehem ella shenayim — hu vehaemtzai, shehachitzonim enam mitztorpin zeh im zeh mippene gippupim haemtzai hammapsiqin benehem. Veim echad mehachitzonim yoter mibbet satayim — hu lebaddo asur, vehaemtzai eno neesar, kevan sheyyesh lo gippupin hammapsiqin, veen tzarik lomar hachitzon hashsheni. Ubilbad shello tehe happirtza shebben emtzai lachitzonim yetera meeser ammot, shehi pirtza oseret, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman shs"b. Abal im haemtzai yoter mibbet satayim — gam hachitzonim asurim, kevan shehem perutzim lo bemilluam. Abal im yachid bekol echad mehachitzonim ushenayim baemtzai, o shenayim bekol echad mehachitzonim veyachid baemtzai — notenim lishnayim hachitzonim kol tzorkan, sheanu roim keillu diyyure haemtzai hem bekol echad mehem, vahare hem shelosha beyachad bekol echad mehem. Vegam baemtzai muttarim kol tzorkan, lepi shehu nechshab kechatzer lechitzonim lepi sebara harishona shennitbaer:

Vekol zeh kesheshshene kotle orek haqqarpep haqqatzar happarutz bemilluo hem boletim veniknasim letok chalal harachab, sheim lo ken en zo pirtza bemilluah, sheeno niqret pirtza bemilluah ella im ken nipratz kol kotel rochbo shel qarpep o chatzer o bayit, abal im haya kotel harochab arok mechalal harochab ubolet tepach lekan vetepach lekan, venipratz kemiddat hechalal, venishtayyer mimmennu happes tepach shemmikkan upas tepach shemmikkan, ap sheen happassin boletin letzad happenim letok hechalal shebben kotle orek ella letzad chutz — en zo pirtza bemilluah, hoil venishtayyeru gippupim qetannim mehakkotel hannipratz. Veap sheggippupim ellu enan nirin lemi sheomed bipnim betok haqqarpep o hechatzer o habbayit hannipratz bemilluo, kevan shehem nirim lemi sheomed bachutz — niddonin mishshum passin lappirtza, kemo shehallechi hannireh mibbachutz velo mibbipnim niddon mishshum lechi lemaboy, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman shs"g. Veim ken gam ken kan hare haomed chutz laqqarpep haqqatzar, dehaynu betok qarpep harachab, nirin lo ellu gippupim harechabim haodepim mikkan umikkan lappirtza keillu hem shiyyurin vegippupin mikkotel harochab shel haqqatzar, velo nipratz ella beemtzao bilbad. Mah sheen ken keshekkotle orko shel haqqatzar boletim veniknasim letok hechalal harachab, azay nikkar venireh shehaggippupim hallalu enam mikkotel rochbo shel haqqatzar. Vehu sherashe ketalim ellu habboletim shamma hem muplagim sham g' tepachim berochab min kotle orek qarpep harachab shebbetziddam, kegon sheggippupim ellu yesh beorek kol echad mehem g' tepachim. Abal im enam muplagim mehem g' tepachim, hare hem kilbadim usenipim sham letzad kotle orek harachab, vehaavir shebbenehem hu kesatum. Venimtza sheyyesh sham gippupim leqarpep haqqatzar, dehaynu merashe kotle orko ad kotle orek harachab, shehem pachot mig' tepachim mikkan upachot mig' tepachim mikkan, veen kan pirtza bemilluah:

Vekol sheen sham pirtza bemilluah, hare kol echad veechad reshut leatzman, veen notenim lahem bekol echad mehem ella bet satayim. Veim yesh beechad mehem yoter mibbet satayim — hu lebaddo asur vehashshear muttarim, kevan sheenam perutzim zeh lezeh bemilluam, veen bepirtza yoter meeser:
